chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Vancouver, 2026. World Cup: Canada against Qatar. Tajon Buchanan drives in from the right and shoots. It deflects up... and Jonathan David volleys it first time. Goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. David keeps moving in the box, so he is ready when the ball pops up. Eyes on the ball, then a right-footed volley.

chapters.label: Bottom corner
chapters.text: Into the bottom corner! David scores a hat-trick, and Canada win their first ever World Cup game.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn, strikers: keep moving in the box. When the ball comes to you, hit it first time, before the defender can block it.
